socfpga_ddr.c

Agilex 5 DDR bring-up for the OCRAM build.  Other builds compile a ddr_init() that returns 0 and does not program the controller.

Types
reset_type

Reset type from bits 31:29 of boot scratch cold 3.  get_reset_type_str() turns these values into text.

POR_RESET

Value 0. Text is Power-On.

WARM_RESET

Value 1. Text is Warm.

COLD_RESET

Value 2. Text is Cold.

NCONFIG

Value 3. Text is NCONFIG.

JTAG_CONFIG

Value 4. Text is JTAG Config.

RSU_RECONFIG

Value 5. Text is RSU Reconfig.

get_reset_type
static inline enum reset_type get_reset_type(
uint32_t 
sys_reg
)

Takes bits 31:29 of sys_reg and returns them as a reset_type.  The caller passes the boot scratch cold 3 register value.  This function does not read the register itself.

Parameters
sys_reg
uint32_t

Register value that holds the reset-type field.

Returns

The reset_type value in bits 31:29.

get_reset_type_str
const char *get_reset_type_str(
enum 
reset_type 
reset_t
)

Returns the short name for a reset type.  The names are Power-On, Warm, Cold, NCONFIG, JTAG Config, and RSU Reconfig. Bring-up prints the name it returns.

Parameters
reset_t
enum reset_type

A reset_type value.

Returns

The matching name, or "Unknown" when reset_t is not one of the six values.

is_ddr_init_hang
static inline bool is_ddr_init_hang(
void
)

Reports whether DDR init was still in progress at reset.  Reads boot scratch POR 0 and returns true when bit 0 is set.  Bring-up treats that as a hang before this reset.

Returns

true if the init-in-progress bit is set, otherwise false.

ddr_init_inprogress
static inline void ddr_init_inprogress(
bool 
start
)

Sets or clears the DDR init-in-progress bit.  The bit is bit 0 of boot scratch POR 0.

Parameters
start
bool

true sets the bit. false clears it.

Returns

Nothing.

config_io96b_csr_addr
static void config_io96b_csr_addr(
bool 
is_dualemif,
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Chooses how many IO96B instances are used and writes their CSR bases.  A dual-EMIF handoff uses two instances. Anything else uses one.  Instance 0 is at 0x18400000. Instance 1, when used, is at 0x18800000.

Parameters
is_dualemif
bool

true for two EMIF interfaces.

io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Receives num_instance and the CSR addresses.

Returns

Nothing.

hps_ocram_dbe_status
static inline bool hps_ocram_dbe_status(
void
)

Reads boot scratch cold 3 and returns true when bit 0 is set.  That bit is the OCRAM double-bit error flag.  Bring-up uses it when deciding whether to run full memory init.

Returns

true when bit 0 is set, otherwise false.

ddr_ecc_dbe_status
static inline bool ddr_ecc_dbe_status(
void
)

Reads boot scratch cold 3 and returns true when bit 1 is set.  That bit is the DDR double-bit error flag.  Bring-up uses it to force a calibration retry and full memory init.

Returns

true when bit 1 is set, otherwise false.

sdram_set_firewall_non_f2sdram
static void sdram_set_firewall_non_f2sdram(
void
)

Programs the non-secure MPU and non-MPU DDR firewall windows.

Each bank whose size is not zero gets a window. The window starts 1 MB above the bank start and ends at the last byte of the bank.  The same base and limit are written to the CCU DMI0 and DMI1 firewalls, and the enable bit for that bank is set.

Returns

Nothing.

sdram_set_firewall_f2sdram
static void sdram_set_firewall_f2sdram(
void
)

Programs the FPGA-to-SDRAM firewall window.

Uses the same 1 MB offset and end address as the MPU firewall.  Writes each bank through the TBU-to-NoC register window and sets that bank's enable bit. Banks whose size is zero are skipped.

Returns

Nothing.

sdram_set_firewall
static void sdram_set_firewall(
void
)

Opens both DDR firewalls.  Calls sdram_set_firewall_non_f2sdram() and then sdram_set_firewall_f2sdram().

Returns

Nothing.

socfpga_ddr_init_internal
static int socfpga_ddr_init_internal(
handoff 
*
hoff_ptr
)

Brings up DDR on the Agilex 5 OCRAM build.

Reads the reset type from bits 31:29 of boot scratch cold 3.  JTAG config returns -EOPNOTSUPP and does not touch IO96B registers.  Bit 0 of hoff_ptr->ddr_config selects dual-port. Bit 1 selects dual-EMIF.

Any other reset sets the init-in-progress bit, programs the IO96B CSR addresses and the MPFE sideband bits, and checks calibration. A failed calibration, or a set DDR double-bit error flag, calls trig_mem_cal().  The function then reads the DDR type, size, and ECC state. Inline ECC shrinks the reported size with GET_INLINE_ECC_HW_DDR_SIZE(). Bank 0 is stored at DRAM_BASE. If that size is smaller than 0x80000000 bytes, the function returns -EINVAL.

When ECC is on, a double-bit error in the ECC log calls mailbox_reset_cold(), which does not return. Warm and cold resets skip full memory init unless an OCRAM double-bit flag, a DDR double-bit flag, or a previous hang is set.

The function then opens the DDR firewall, allows secure and non-secure access to the MPFE CSR registers, and clears the init-in-progress bit.

Parameters
hoff_ptr
handoff*

Handoff data. Only ddr_config is read.

Returns

0 on success.  -EOPNOTSUPP for a JTAG config reset.  -EINVAL if that DDR size is smaller than 0x80000000 bytes.  A negative error code returned by one of the mailbox steps.  Does not return if mailbox_reset_cold() is called.
